name: over head straight arm stretch
description: Straight arms overhead lengthen the chest, shoulders and sides of your back. A simple full-reach stretch.
instructions: Kneel upright with your arms relaxed by your sides.
Raise both straight arms overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reach upward and slightly back while keeping your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Hold a comfortable stretch for 20 to 30 seconds, then lower your arms slowly.
